newsitem.title: USA: West Marine July same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: West Marine July same-store sales up.

text.p: West Marine Inc said on Thursday its same-store sales for the four week period ended July 26 for the West Marine locations increased 6.2 percent.
The company said its net sales in July 1997 were $45.6 million, an increase of 11.2 percent over net sales of $41 million for the same period a year ago.

The company said it acquired E&B Marine on June 17, 1996 and accordingly, net sales for 1996 do not include the sales of E&B Marine for the period prior to the acquisition date. Same-store sales at E&B locations increased 5.6 percent.
Comparable store net sales for the total company for July 1997 increased 6.0 percent.

Comparable store net sales for the latest 30 weeks for West Marine locations increased by 4.2 percent. Net sales for the latest thirty weeks were $262.1 million, an increase of 37.6 percent from sales of $190.4 million for the 30-week period a year ago.
West Marine is a major retailer of recreational boating supplies and apparel.
